title: Adding, Verifying, Re-Routing and Removing Payout Methods
content:
A Payout Methods method moves through four states: pending verification, active, on hold and removed. A new method starts in pending verification and becomes active when it passes verification.

## Terms

1. **Verification.** A new method is verified by the rail's verification method within the rail's verification deadline in calendar days after it was added, with at most the rail's number of failed attempts (3 on every rail); otherwise it is discarded.
2. **The verification deadline.** A payout method is verified only within the rail's verification deadline in calendar days after it was added; the days are counted from the date added on the method's record, and verification on the last day stands.
3. **Changing the default.** Changing the default never moves money already released.
4. **Listing routing.** Listing routing applies to releases from the day it is saved.
5. **Removal.** Removing a method never cancels a transfer already sent.

## The verification deadline in cases (hypothetical dates)

The deadline day is the date added plus the rail's deadline in calendar days; verification on that day stands, and verification after it does not.

| Rail and deadline | Date added | Verification date | Verification stands? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct Deposit (ACH), 10 days | 2026-04-01 | 2026-04-11 | Yes: the last day |
| Direct Deposit (ACH), 10 days | 2026-04-01 | 2026-04-12 | No: one day late |
| Fast Pay Debit Card, 3 days | 2026-04-01 | 2026-04-04 | Yes: the last day |
| International Wire Transfer, 14 days | 2026-04-01 | 2026-04-15 | Yes: the last day |

## States and how they change

| From | To | Brought about by | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pending verification | Active | The system | The method passes verification and can receive transfers |
| Pending verification | Removed | The system | Verification was not completed in time and the method is discarded |
| Active | On hold | The system | A transfer to the method was returned, or the method went dormant |
| On hold | Active | Support | Reactivated after the host's updated details were re-verified |
| Active or on hold | Removed | The host | The host removes the method |

## Points of judgement

- *A host changes the default on a Friday: does money released to the old default on Thursday move?* No; changing the default never moves money already released.
- *A host saves listing routing today: do yesterday's releases follow it?* No; routing applies to releases from the day it is saved.
- *A host removes a method after a transfer to it was sent: is the transfer cancelled?* No; removal never cancels a transfer already sent.
